name: University of Neuchâtel
feeMethod: Sets one course fee for foreign students, the same in every faculty, so every major costs the same.
description: The University of Neuchâtel (UniNE) is a public French-speaking university founded as an academy in 1838 and a university since 1909. It has four faculties: humanities and social sciences, science, law, and economics and business.
whyIncluded: Neuchatel accepts the Singapore-Cambridge GCE A-Level for bachelor's entry (3 H2, 1 H1, 2 O-levels, grade C each), plus French at B2 level.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own monthly budget for a student renting a room, using the middle of its ranges, for 12 months a year. Excludes fees, health insurance and taxes.
livingCosts.notes: UniNE 'Managing your finances' page (monthly, ranges; midpoints used): housing = rent incl. bills 370-700 (535) + cleaning 20-40 (30) = 565; food = meals (canteen) 400-500 (450); transport = travel 10-220 (115); personal = clothes 70-100 (85) + hairdresser/hygiene 30-50 (40) + pocket money/phone 150-200 (175) + doctor/dentist/optician 60 = 360. Excluded: registration/tuition/materials 200-400, sickness/accident insurance 350-380, taxes/AHV 40-80. UniNE total for independent students CHF 1,700-2,780. Page undated, read 2026-10-07.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Economics and Business
programmes.feeBasis: Neuchâtel's cantonal course fee for foreign students whose parents live abroad, CHF 1,400 a year (same in all faculties), plus CHF 150 fixed and exam fees.
programmes.summary: Yearly course fee for foreign students whose parents live abroad, plus fixed and exam fees. A one-off CHF 100 fee applies to applicants with foreign qualifications.
programmes.notes: Neuchatel cantonal Arrete concernant le montant de la finance d'inscription percue par l'Universite de Neuchatel (18 Feb 2004, status 1 March 2024), published by UniNE: art. 3 course and laboratory fees per year CHF 1,400 for students of foreign nationality whose parents live abroad (CHF 850 for Swiss); art. 2 fixed fees CHF 120 a year; art. 5 exam fees CHF 30 a year; compulsory = 150. Art. 5bis (since 1 Aug 2014): CHF 100 processing fee for applicants with a foreign entrance qualification. The optional FEN student federation fee (CHF 15 a semester) is excluded. Fee history: the amounts have been unchanged since 2004 (later amendments only renamed the department and added art. 5bis in 2014), and the version in force from 1 March 2024 covers 2024-25 and 2025-26, so those rows use the same figures. 3-year (180 ECTS) Faculty of Economics and Business bachelor, taught mainly in French. Fix 2026-10-15: the arrete PDF (a_finance_inscription_unine.pdf) now returns 404; the source is UniNE's 'Taxes universitaires' page, which gives the same amounts per semester for foreign students whose parents live abroad: course and laboratory fee CHF 700 (= CHF 1,400 a year), fixed fee CHF 60 and exam fee CHF 15 (= CHF 150 a year), plus the optional FEN membership CHF 15 (students may decline it at admission, so excluded); total CHF 790 a semester. oneOffFees changed from 100 to 0 on the current and history rows because UniNE's admission pages say the CHF 100 application fee for foreign diplomas 'est deduit des premieres taxes universitaires' for admitted students, i.e. it is credited against the first fees (SCHEMA: deposits credited to tuition are not one-off fees). Sources: https://www.unine.ch/admission/taxes-universitaires/ and https://www.unine.ch/admission/admission-bachelor/delais-et-frais-dinscription-pour-les-bachelors/ (read 2026-10-15).
